links.outcome: Diagnostic agreement (Cohen's kappa) with specialist diagnosis, ML classifier vs zero-shot LLM on same data
links.effect: ML classifier kappa 0.46 vs LLM 0.26 (95% CI of difference 0.15-0.25); ML had higher macro precision, specificity, F-value; LLM higher macro sensitivity.
links.quote: The machine learning classifier showed significantly higher diagnostic agreement with the specialist than the LLM (Cohen's κ: 0.46 vs. 0.26; 95% confidence interval of the difference: 0.15-0.25).

screen.reason: Empirical study comparing diagnostic accuracy and agreement of a supervised ML model vs. zero-shot GPT-4 on structured headache questionnaire data without testing a deployment practice.
